newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker quotes weaker, talks thin.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker quotes weaker, talks thin.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes were weaker on Monday amid thin talk, fewer enquiries and in line with overnight losses in crude values, traders said.
As enquiries slipped from last week's levels, suppliers lowered their offers to get rid of stocks, they said.

The 380-cst grade was quoted by majors at around $97/$98 per tonne and the 180-cst grade was at $102/$104, about $1-$2 per tonne lower than last week's levels. MDO and gas oil were at about $195 and $210 respectively.
